skill.name: limrun-xcode-bazel
skill.description: Build a Bazel-based iOS / macOS / Apple app on Limrun's remote build execution (RBE) instead of a local Mac, and install it on a remote iOS simulator. Use when the project is a Bazel workspace (MODULE.bazel / WORKSPACE) building rules_apple / rules_swift targets and the user wants to `bazel build` it or run it on a simulator, or when a `--config=limrun` build or install misbehaves. To then tap, type, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the running app, use limrun-ios-simulator. For non-Bazel (plain xcodebuild) projects use limrun-xcode instead.
skill.summary: Build and troubleshoot Bazel Apple projects on Limrun remote Mac workers, with optional simulator installation and asset uploads.
skill.author: limrun-inc

content.user_title: Build Bazel Apple Apps on Remote Macs
content.value_statement: Apple Bazel builds usually require local Xcode and compatible Mac hardware. This skill guides remote builds, simulator installation, uploads, verification, and troubleshooting through Limrun.
actual_capabilities: Guides Limrun RBE setup from a Bazel workspace root.
Provides the required SHA256 Bazel build invocation pattern.
Explains remote iOS simulator attachment and automatic app installation.
Supports one-time and automatic uploads of successful app builds.
Distinguishes remote execution from local and remote cache hits.
Diagnoses common Xcode, strategy, platform, cache, and genrule compatibility failures.
limitations: Requires a Bazel workspace using Apple or Swift rules.
Requires the Limrun CLI, authentication, and available remote resources.
Does not interact with the running simulator after installation.
Does not support plain xcodebuild projects or guarantee project-specific Bazel compatibility.

use_cases.title: Build Apple Apps Without a Mac
use_cases.description: Configure and run Bazel Apple builds on remote Mac workers from Linux, Windows, containers, or virtual machines.

use_cases.title: Prepare Remote Build Pipelines
use_cases.description: Verify remote execution, manage uploaded artifacts, and apply repeatable Limrun settings for continuous integration workflows.

use_cases.title: Resolve Bazel RBE Failures
use_cases.description: Trace Xcode pins, execution strategies, platform properties, cache behavior, and sandbox-hostile genrules that prevent remote builds.

prompt_templates.title: Check Project Compatibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this repository can use Limrun RBE. Identify the Bazel workspace root, Apple targets, required tools, and authentication prerequisites.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment before starting a remote build

prompt_templates.title: Build an Apple Target
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Limrun RBE for this workspace and build the specified Apple target. Use the generated configuration and report the build result.
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard remote build from a prepared repository

prompt_templates.title: Run on a Simulator
prompt_templates.prompt: Build this single iOS app target, attach a remote simulator, and confirm automatic installation. Share only the user-facing simulator link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Remote build followed by simulator installation

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Remote Execution
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate why this Bazel Apple build fails or uses cache instead of remote workers. Check execution strategies, Xcode settings, platform properties, and logs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting of project-specific RBE behavior

output_examples.input: Assess this rules_apple workspace before I start a remote iOS build.
output: Workspace root and Apple target identified.
Limrun authentication and CLI prerequisites listed.
Project settings that may conflict with remote execution highlighted.

output_examples.input: Explain why my successful build does not prove that actions ran remotely.
output: Local action cache and remote cache behavior distinguished.

output_examples.input: Prepare this iOS target for simulator installation and a preview asset.
output: Asset lifetime and preview access summarized.

best_practices: Run Limrun setup from the Bazel workspace root.
Use the exact generated build command with SHA256 digests.
Build one application target when automatic simulator installation is required.
anti_patterns: Do not hand-edit generated Limrun configuration for routine setup.
Do not treat cache hits as proof of remote action execution.
Do not force Apple actions locally when the client lacks compatible Xcode tools.

faq.question: Can I use this skill without a local Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. Limrun performs Apple build actions on remote Mac workers from supported client environments.

faq.question: Does this skill support plain Xcode projects?
faq.answer: No. It targets Bazel workspaces using Apple or Swift rules. Plain xcodebuild projects need a different workflow.

faq.question: Why is SHA256 required?
faq.answer: Limrun remote caching expects SHA256 digests. Other Bazel digest defaults can cause cache and installation failures.

faq.question: Will a successful build install the app automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, when a simulator is attached and the successful invocation produces one application target.

faq.question: Can the skill control the running simulator?
faq.answer: No. Use a simulator interaction skill for taps, typing, screenshots, element inspection, or recording.

faq.question: How can I prove actions executed remotely?
faq.answer: Create a cache miss and inspect the build process summary for remote actions. Cache hits alone do not prove execution.
